post.description: Required Region access Token scope: files:analyze. Resource operations also require a matching resource ID, resource type, or workspace-wide wildcard. Lists are filtered to permitted resources. Also requires files:read. Discover engines from capabilities: CSV supports DuckDB SQL over table file or Just Bash over its raw UTF-8 text. Bash exposes the selected absolute Workspace path; discover input.path, input.workingDirectory and compatibility aliases on its engine option. Paths refer only to the virtual selected-file snapshot. Parquet supports only DuckDB, and other recognized text only Just Bash. Only the selected snapshot is available; no provider credentials, network, persistent writes or host paths. Limits: 16 MiB input, 64 KiB script, 15 seconds, 1000 rows / 1 MiB output, two active analyses. Large/unsupported files remain downloadable. No implicit retry.

post.description: Required Region access Token scope: Source database: queries:read (also implied by queries:execute); source File System: files:read and files:analyze. Destination additionally requires files:write or queries:execute and its resource grant. Resource operations also require a matching resource ID, resource type, or workspace-wide wildcard. Lists are filtered to permitted resources. Client-supplied snapshot, not attested provenance. Up to 100 columns, 1000 rows, 16 nesting levels and 1 MiB request. Downloads: CSV/JSON/JSON Lines, up to 4 MiB encoded output. Files: conditional create, 256 KiB local / 1 MiB live plus provider limits. Database targets: active live resources, CREATE then one INSERT, each up to 64 KiB and 15 seconds; no transaction across both statements. Name collisions never append/replace. EXPORT_INCOMPLETE or a timeout may leave a new table; inspect before retrying. No automatic retry. Precision strings remain text; CSV renders null as empty and prefixes spreadsheet-formula strings. No result values are audited.
